verdict.rationale: Graphite is a developer-platform SaaS with a CLI and an MCP server, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The pack has no evidence of either: no API versioning scheme or deprecation/sunset policy is documented, and all OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. CLI release numbers (e.g. gt 1.8.4) do not amount to a versioned API with a deprecation policy.
